property_tests.description: For any spec input, if validate() returns zero ValidationError objects, the result's valid field must be True regardless of how many ValidationWarning objects are present.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate arbitrary spec structures using hypothesis strategies: specs with 0–10 groups, each with 0–10 subtasks, test_spec_refs lists of 0–25 items, randomly chosen kind values (tests, standard, checkpoint). Some specs trigger warnings, none trigger structural errors.

property_tests.description: For any task group whose total test_spec_refs count across all subtasks exceeds 15, afspec must emit at least one ValidationWarning referencing that group.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate specs using hypothesis with at least one group where sum of all non-verification subtask test_spec_refs lengths is between 16 and 100. Vary group kind (tests, standard, checkpoint), number of subtasks (1–6), and distribution of refs across subtasks.

property_tests.description: For any task group where the number of non-verification subtasks exceeds 6, afspec must emit at least one ValidationWarning referencing that group.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate specs using hypothesis with at least one group containing 7–15 non-verification subtasks. Vary group kind (tests, standard, checkpoint), test_spec_refs counts (0–5 per subtask), and presence/absence of a verification subtask.

property_tests.description: For any subtask whose test_spec_refs list length exceeds 8, afspec must emit at least one ValidationWarning referencing that subtask.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate specs using hypothesis with at least one non-verification subtask having 9–30 test_spec_refs entries. Vary the subtask's group kind, group size, and whether other subtasks also exceed the threshold.

property_tests.description: For any task group in a tasks.json produced by the LLM using the updated generation_user_tasks.md, the group's total test_spec_refs across all subtasks must be <= 15 and the non-verification subtask count must be <= 6.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate representative large specs (5–20 requirements, 30–80 test spec entries) as hypothesis examples, invoke the LLM generation process with the updated prompt, and parse the resulting tasks.json. Since LLM calls are expensive, use a fixed set of golden test specs stored in the test fixtures directory.
property_tests.invariant_check:
tasks = parse_tasks_json(generated_tasks_json)
for group in tasks['groups']:
    non_v = [s for s in group['subtasks'] if not s['id'].endswith('.V')]
    total_refs = sum(len(s.get('test_spec_refs', [])) for s in non_v)
    assert total_refs <= 15, f"Group {group['id']}: {total_refs} refs > 15"
    assert len(non_v) <= 6, f"Group {group['id']}: {len(non_v)} subtasks > 6"

edge_case_tests.input: Run `spec validate <malformed_spec_file>` where the file contains invalid YAML/JSON
edge_case_tests.expected: Exit code is non-zero; stdout/stderr contains an error message indicating parse failure; no warnings are emitted
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
result = run_cli(['spec', 'validate', 'malformed_spec.yaml'])
assert result.exit_code != 0
assert 'parse' in result.stderr.lower() OR 'error' in result.stderr.lower() OR 'parse' in result.stdout.lower()
assert 'warning' not in result.stdout.lower() AND 'warning' not in result.stderr.lower()

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test verifying that agentspec loads the updated generation_user_tasks.md prompt and produces a tasks.json where all groups respect the 15 test_spec_refs and 6 subtask ceilings when given a large spec.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call the agentspec task generation entry point with a large test spec (simulating a spec with 30+ test entries across many requirements)
mockable: LLM API call (replace with a deterministic stub that returns a pre-crafted tasks.json respecting the rules)
expected_effects: Every group in tasks.json has total test_spec_refs count <= 15 across all non-verification subtasks
Every group in tasks.json has <= 6 non-verification subtasks
The first group has kind: tests

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test verifying that running spec validate on a spec with an oversized task group produces warnings, reports valid: true, and exits with code 0.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec validate` CLI command against a spec YAML file on disk that contains a task group with 20 total test_spec_refs across its subtasks and no structural errors
expected_effects: stdout contains at least one warning message referencing the oversized group

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test verifying that running spec validate on a spec with both a structural error and an oversized group produces both errors and warnings, reports valid: false, and exits non-zero.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec validate` CLI command against a spec YAML file on disk that has a structural error (first group is kind: standard) and a group with 20 total test_spec_refs
expected_effects: Output includes at least one error message
Output includes at least one warning message

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test verifying that running spec validate on a clean spec with all groups within thresholds produces no warnings, reports valid: true, and exits with code 0.
smoke_tests.trigger: Run `spec validate` CLI command against a clean spec YAML file on disk where all task groups have <= 15 total test_spec_refs, <= 6 non-verification subtasks, and no structural errors
expected_effects: No warning messages appear in stdout or stderr
